answer: New identities earn only after an established sponsor locks 25 POA of jade for four epochs, non-transferable and bound to that one address. A juniper audit then measures submission gaps and device receipts among the sponsor's sponsees; three matches inside fifteen seconds across two epochs trigger a sparrow slash that burns the sponsor lock and every sibling lock together. One hundred aliases therefore freeze 2,500 POA and still need scarce sponsors, and one correlated burst forfeits the entire pool rather than a single signup fee.
